# Ferrotensor

> Ferrotensor is a Rust framework for tensors, autograd and LoRA fine-tuning of small language models on the GPU through wgpu and WGSL kernels (Vulkan, Metal or DX12). The `ferrotensor` command plans, fine-tunes, chats with, merges and evaluates LoRA adapters for Llama-style models, exports them as GGUF files for llama.cpp and Ollama, and trains a small model from scratch with a byte-level or a learned BPE tokenizer (`pretrain --tokenizer bpe`); `plan`, `finetune`, `train`, `eval`, `generate`, `chat`, `merge`, `export-gguf`, `pretrain`, `q4-report` and `info` take `--json`, and every command uses the same exit codes.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what Ferrotensor is, the commands, install, quickstart, measured results
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the CLI for coding agents and scripts: JSON output per command, exit codes, picking a model, rules for changing the code
- [CLI reference](ferrotensor-cli/README.md): every `ferrotensor` command and flag group, with measured memory numbers

## Guides

- [LoRA SFT walkthrough](docs/examples/lora-sft.md): fine-tune, evaluate and sample SmolLM2 end to end, with real output
- [Adapters in PyTorch](docs/examples/peft-export.md): export a LoRA adapter as a Hugging Face PEFT directory, or merge it into a standalone model with `ferrotensor merge`
- [Text classification](docs/examples/classify.md): LoRA fine-tuning of a decoder as a classifier
- [Testing on your GPU](docs/testing-on-your-gpu.md): check that the kernels pass on a GPU and report the result
- [Use cases](docs/use-cases.md): runnable programs with the tensor API

## Internals

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): one tensor op from the Rust API to a WGSL kernel, GPU op batching, and how the crates fit together
- [Writing a kernel](docs/writing-a-kernel.md): adding a GPU op
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, tests and the PR process
